notes: All 6 'move to folder' fields are now correctly recognized in reports, and the app's own preview matches the report colors.
changelog: Added: all 6 'move to folder' fields (bad-files, signatures, content analysis x2, HEX/Text scanner, invalid data) are now recognized automatically when building a report — any matching folder is flagged, even if that specific tool wasn't run this session
Fixed: the bad-files folder field could show a name you never actually typed — now stays empty until you fill it in
Fixed: the signature-verification folder name wasn't being recognized in reports at all — now works like every other folder field
Fixed: an 'Uncertain' folder match now always counts, not only when whole-folder verification is turned on
Fixed: the Generator's own preview now shows Uncertain (orange) files correctly, matching the final report
Modernized: interface language now follows your Windows language automatically on first run
Modernized: non-photo files no longer falsely show 'OK' in thumbnail reports — only files actually checked get a status
Modernized: turning verification off no longer regenerates all thumbnails from scratch — much faster
Fixed: switching the source folder in thumbnail settings could silently load images for the wrong folder
Fixed: Uncertain and unverified files are now counted correctly everywhere — top summary and per-folder stats
Added: 'Verify certain/uncertain across the whole folder' option for accurate full-folder damage counts
Added: '% uncertain by' percentage option in Settings
